timeline.summary: After Sarkhan sends Ugin into slumber in 3279 AR, Dromoka's brood commits systematic genocide against the Abzan.
timeline.quote: Dromoka and her brood thus laid a systematic genocide on the Abzan, to the point of utter desperation.

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Under Dromoka necromancy is banned and the Kin-Trees razed, but ancestor worship persists in secret.
timeline.quote: necromancy was banned, the Kin-Trees were razed, and all forms of ancestral communion were strictly prohibited.

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "Revival of the Abzan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The rebellion grows until Dromoka is defeated alongside the other dragonlords.
timeline.quote: eventually leading to Dromoka's defeat alongside the other dragonlords.

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "Revival of the Abzan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dromoka outlaws trafficking with spirits as necromancy, and the practice is restored after Dromoka is overthrown.
timeline.quote: and when Dromoka was overthrown, it was officially restored.

citation.text: "Spirit", section "Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Some Abzan spirits abandoned during Dromoka's reign turn malevolent and form ancestral maelstroms.
timeline.quote: Some Abzan spirits became malevolent after being abandoned during Dromoka's reign.

citation.text: "Spirit", section "Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The heads of the clan houses gather to swear kinship, and Anafenza receives them at the Amber Throne.
timeline.quote: The houses had elected Anafenza to be khan

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: As the Sultai retreat, Anafenza discovers Abzan soldiers slaughtering their own kin at the fallen fortress.
timeline.quote: She saw Abzan butchering Abzan.

citation.text: "Bond and Blood" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Tasigur sends ambassadors to an Abzan outpost, bringing infectious rats as the true envoys.
timeline.quote: When Tasigur sent his ambassadors to the Abzan outpost, the true envoys were not the naga but the infectious rats they carried with them.

citation.text: Typhoid Rats (Fate Reforged, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ojutai is intrigued by the maneuvers of the Abzan formation.
timeline.quote: The maneuvers of the Abzan formation intrigued Ojutai in both their complexity and their futility.

citation.text: Whisk Away (Fate Reforged, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Without the naga's necromancy, the zombies disperse or crumble, and soldiers desert as Abzan and Jeskai raids grow.
timeline.quote: The months since had been one long slide into a perfect fulfillment of those prophetic words.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Daghatar convenes twenty Abzan advisors at Mer-Ek, and Reyhan and Merel argue between striking at Dromoka and enduring.
timeline.quote: We bring down Dromoka, and her brood will scatter.

citation.text: "No End and No Beginning" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Dromoka's brood massacres the Abzan until Khan Daghatar is brought before her and ends the kin-tree traditions.
timeline.quote: he ordered the end of the Abzan kin-tree traditions, installing instead a pact with the dragons.

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "Broods of the Dragonlords". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Reyhan refuses to kneel to the dragon Dromoka, rallies the Abzan as their final khan, and dies in the khanfall.
timeline.quote: Reyhan refused to kneel to a dragon.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Nur calms an ancestral maelstrom of spirits that gather behind Ajani.
timeline.quote: Nur's work proved uncannily effective.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Over a meal, Nur urges Ajani to accept Abzan help and warns he is dying slowly of spirit.
timeline.quote: This isn't living. This is just a death deferred.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Abzan outriders arrest Narset and Elspeth near the stormplains and take them to Arashin for questioning.
timeline.quote: Incarceration by the Abzan was not part of Narset's plan.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset persuades an impatient Elspeth to wait one more hour, explaining the Jeskai-Abzan tension over the dead.
timeline.quote: Dromoka all but informed the Abzan that their clan would be eradicated if they didn't forswear their ancestral worship.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ajani prepares to lead Abzan riders in a gazelle hunt, unsettled by the herd and Nur's words.
timeline.quote: Much to his chagrin, Nur had gotten into his head with that last conversation.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: A wave of magic panics the herd and the Abzan dragons throw their riders as a huge red dragon rises with a flight of smaller ones.
timeline.quote: a dragon of improbable size: red-scaled, triumphant, roaring as dozens of its smaller brethren rose to join it.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Anafenza Mevak's Kin-Tree is recovered after Dromoka's reign.
timeline.quote: The Kin-Tree of Anafenza Mevak was the first recovered after Dromoka's reign

citation.text: Tree of Redemption (Tarkir: Dragonstorm Commander, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Abzan forces rally and drive back Sarkhan's dragon horde.
timeline.quote: The Abzan forces rallied to the call, driving back Sarkhan's feral dragon horde.

citation.text: United Battlefront (Tarkir: Dragonstorm Promos, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: By 4564 Gvar has rejoined the Abzan as a krumar captain.
timeline.quote: he had joined the Abzan again as a krumar

citation.text: "Gvar Barzeel", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Stormplains temple, Narset, Elspeth and the Abzan fight Sarkhan's wild dragons; Ugin appears and defeats Sarkhan with ghostfire, though Bolas has escaped.
timeline.quote: Ugin appeared and immediately defeated Sarkhan with his ghostfire

citation.text: "Narset", section "Searching for answers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A protracted siege of Qatros Karst City by the Sultai over mining rights around 4564 AR kills over a hundred Abzan.
timeline.quote: A conflict over mining rights with the Sultai Brood led to a protracted siege against the city around 4564 AR

citation.text: "Shifting Wastes", section "Known locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Through Narset's research, the clans learn to summon and bind spirit dragons and overthrow the dragonlords who had ruled the plane.
timeline.quote: the clans were able to overthrow the dragonlords who had ruled the plane

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dromoka rules over the Abzan from the Great Aerie, outlawing necromancy and destroying Kin-Trees to sever ties to ancestors.
timeline.quote: outlawing necromancy and destroying Kin-Trees to sever the people’s ties to their ancestors

citation.text: "Arashin", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arashin is transformed into the spiritual and political center of the revived Abzan clan.
timeline.quote: transformed into the spiritual and political center of the revived Abzan clan

citation.text: "Arashin", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Sarkhan saves Ugin and Ugin sleeps, dragon storms intensify and Dromoka's brood carries out a systematic genocide of the Abzan.
timeline.quote: Dromoka and her brood thus laid a systematic genocide on the Abzan

citation.text: "Daghatar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Felothar flees beneath the Wastes and rises to lead the Abzan rebellion.
timeline.quote: eventually rising to leadership in the rebellion

citation.text: "Felothar Zanhar", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Riza ordered a fall back to the oasis at Canyon Falls to await the larger patrol.
timeline.quote: Riza announced that they would fall back to the oasis at Canyon Falls

citation.text: "Ogan Shieldmender", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The larger Abzan patrol arrived with a siege elephant as the Mardu converged.
timeline.quote: The larger patrol was coming.

citation.text: "Ogan Shieldmender", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Riza's patrol found a shepherds' camp burned by the Mardu and followed the horde.
timeline.quote: one of the shepherds' summer camps had been ravaged and burned to the ground by Mardu with not a single survivor

citation.text: "Riza", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As the Mardu converged, an Abzan siege elephant of the larger patrol appeared.
timeline.quote: The larger patrol was coming.

citation.text: "Riza", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Mardu capture the Abzan city of Sandsteppe Gate.

citation.text: "Sandsteppe", section "Known locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
